```js
import orders from './orders.json' with {type:'json'};

export async function listTools() {
  return [
    {
      name: 'order_status',
      description: 'Get the current status of an order, optionally including its chronological history.',
      inputSchema: {
        type: 'object',
        properties: {
          order_id: { type: 'string', description: 'The order identifier.' },
          include_history: { type: 'boolean', description: 'Whether to include the chronological history.', default: false }
        },
        required: ['order_id'],
        additionalProperties: false
      }
    }
  ];
}

export async function callTool(name, args) {
  if (name !== 'order_status') {
    return errorResult(`Unknown tool: ${name}`);
  }
  // Validate args
  if (typeof args !== 'object' || args === null || Array.isArray(args)) {
    return errorResult('Invalid arguments');
  }
  const allowed = new Set(['order_id', 'include_history']);
  for (const key of Object.keys(args)) {
    if (!allowed.has(key)) {
      return errorResult(`Unexpected field: ${key}`);
    }
  }
  if (typeof args.order_id !== 'string' || args.order_id.length === 0) {
    return errorResult('order_id must be a non-empty string');
  }
  if ('include_history' in args && typeof args.include_history !== 'boolean') {
    return errorResult('include_history must be a boolean');
  }
  const order = orders[args.order_id];
  if (!order) {
    return errorResult(`Order not found: ${args.order_id}`);
  }
  const includeHistory = args.include_history === true;
  let text = `status: ${order.status}`;
  if (includeHistory) {
    text += `\nhistory: ${order.history.join(', ')}`;
  }
  return { content: [{ type: 'text', text }] };
}
```
